verdict.rationale: The engine and Editor MCP server are published as versioned npm packages (playcanvas 2.22.2, @playcanvas/editor-mcp-server 0.7.1), so the APIs do carry version numbers. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, and no OpenAPI spec was found for the REST API. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy or timeline, explicit API versioning or semver guarantees for the Engine, Editor and REST APIs, changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration.
